definitions.explanation: Abbreviation of {男子高生|だんしこうせい}, referring to male high school students.

examples.japanese: DK⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧
examples.english: A game popular among high school boys.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧DKになった。
examples.english: My son is already a high school student now.

examples.japanese: DK⟦と→と：00512_to⟧JK⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{部活|ぶかつ}→部活：05377_bukatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: High school boys and girls are doing club activities together.

notes:
DK is an abbreviation of {男子高校生|だんしこうこうせい} (male high school student). D stands for ⟦{男子|だんし}→男子：03425_danshi⟧ (male) and K for ⟦{高校生|こうこうせい}→高校生：01580_koukousei⟧ (high school student).

USAGE:
Much less commonly used than its female counterpart JK (⟦{女子高生|じょしこうせい}→女子高生：12381_joshikousei⟧). Appears mainly in:
- Marketing targeting male teenagers
- Internet and social media discussions
- Casual speech among young people

REGISTER:
Informal. Not used in formal writing or official contexts. In formal settings, use {男子高校生|だんしこうこうせい} instead.

RELATED ABBREVIATIONS:
- JK: ⟦{女子高生|じょしこうせい}→女子高生：12381_joshikousei⟧ (high school girl) — far more widely known
- JC: ⟦{女子中学生|じょしちゅうがくせい}→女子中学生：23376_joshichuugakusei⟧ (middle school girl)
- DK: {男子高校生|だんしこうこうせい} (high school boy)
